name: experiment-anatomy
description: Opus-driven deep review of a single experiment codebase (any platform — Psychtoolbox / PsychoPy / PsychoJS-Builder / mgl / jsPsych / lab.js / custom — any paradigm, any session count). Multi-pass workflow with a grounded one-question-at-a-time interview. Emits a strict PostgreSQL-feedable JSON spec covering identity, platform, session→block→trial hierarchy, manipulated variables with role, conditions, parameters, saved variables across 5 scales, display outputs, storage paths, and explicit reproducibility / rigor scores with evidence. Researchers run /experiment-anatomy:analyze in their experiment directory; the output is shape-identical across paradigms so a lab DB can aggregate everyone's specs.
